children: US interconnect products maker's fiscal Q3 sales rose 21% to a record high
Non-GAAP net income and adjusted EBITDA both increased sharply yr/yr
Margin gains driven by shift to higher-value solutions and diversified markets
Company backlog stands at $19.8 mln as of September 14, 2026
Company says bookings and backlog are indicators of future revenue
HIGHER-VALUE SOLUTIONS - Co said margin expansion and profitability gains were driven by shift to custom cabling and integrated systems offerings
MARKET DIVERSIFICATION - Co said expansion into fast-growing markets like aerospace, edge data centers, AI infrastructure, transportation, and public safety reduced reliance on wireless carriers
STRONG DEMAND AND BOOKINGS - Co reported robust bookings and backlog, supporting record sales growth
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the electrical components & equipment peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for RF Industries Ltd is $17.00, about 64.7% above its September 11 closing price of $10.32
The stock recently traded at 12 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 30 three months ago
